title_en: Refactor a loop into a list comprehension
spec_html_en: heavy_pallet_ids(pallets, limit) returns the id of every pallet dict in pallets whose weight is strictly greater than limit. It already works with a manual loop; rewrite its body as a single list comprehension.
canonical:
def heavy_pallet_ids(pallets, limit):
    return [pallet['id'] for pallet in pallets if pallet['weight'] > limit]
